RESULT: DONE
CHANGED: web/app/mindmaps/[key]/board/page.tsx, web/app/mindmaps/[key]/board/BoardView.tsx, web/app/mindmaps/[key]/board/BoardContext.tsx, web/app/mindmaps/[key]/board/ItemDetail.tsx, web/app/mindmaps/[key]/board/WaitingOnYou.tsx
TESTS: `npx tsc --noEmit` (from web/) -> no output, no errors
NOTES:
- I didn't run the board in a browser or against the backend. The only check was the type check.
- The web work-items endpoint response (`WorkItemListOutput` in `_work_item_common.py`) has no top-level `team_id` today. `page.tsx` reads `team_id` from the top level and falls back to `items[0].team_id`. If neither is present, it skips the workflow fetch and shows every item in the 'unmapped' column.
- A 404 from the workflow endpoint is treated as "no active workflow", so all items go in 'unmapped'. Other workflow errors throw.
- `BoardView` takes `teamId` as a prop and renders `<WaitingOnYou mapKey teamId items>` only when it is set. The stubs return null and mark their props with `void props` to satisfy the strict unused-parameter check.
- `BoardView` skips `router.refresh()` on its first mount and refreshes only when `boardRefreshKey` changes.
